title: A Computationally Efficient and Rate-Optimal Algorithm for Adversarial Linear MDPs with (Aggregate) Bandit Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.30801v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study episodic linear Markov decision processes with unknown transitions, adversarial losses, and bandit feedback. The state-of-the-art result for this setting (Liu et al., 2024) either achieves $\sqrt{K}$ regret with a computationally inefficient algorithm or achieves suboptimal $K^{3/4}$ regret, where $K$ is the number of episodes. Our work gives the first $\sqrt{K}$ regret with a polynomial-time algorithm. Our method reduces adversarial linear MDPs to adversarial linear bandits whose action set consists of policies' expected feature vectors. The central challenge is that this action set is unknown and can be estimated only through exploration. We address this challenge by constructing an approximate separation oracle for the action set that either generates executable policies from queried features, or refines an outer approximation of the action set. translated_title: 一种用于具有（聚合）老虎机反馈的对抗性线性马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的计算高效且速率最优的算法
translated_abstract: 我们研究具有未知转移、对抗性损失和老虎机反馈的回合制线性马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）。针对该设置的现有最优结果（Liu et al., 2024）要么通过计算效率低下的算法实现 $\sqrt{K}$ 遗憾，要么实现次优的 $K^{3/4}$ 遗憾，其中 $K$ 为回合数。我们的工作首次给出了以多项式时间算法实现 $\sqrt{K}$ 遗憾的结果。我们的方法将对抗性线性MDP归约为对抗性线性老虎机问题，其后者的动作集由各策略的期望特征向量组成。核心挑战在于该动作集是未知的，只能通过探索进行估计。我们通过为该动作集构建一个近似分离预言机来应对这一挑战，该预言机要么根据查询的特征生成可执行的策略，要么细化该动作集的外部近似。该方法借鉴了 van Erven et al. (2025) 的归约方法……
tldr: 本文首次提出多项式时间算法，通过将对抗性线性MDP归约为动作集未知的对抗性线性老虎机并构建近似分离预言机，实现了速率最优且计算高效的 $\sqrt{K}$ 遗憾界。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first polynomial-time algorithm achieving rate-optimal $\sqrt{K}$ regret for adversarial linear MDPs with bandit feedback, by reducing to adversarial linear bandits with an unknown action set and constructing an approximate separation oracle.
